tagline: Design, fund, build, operate, and preserve mosques that can serve generations.

hero.headline: From an empty plot to a living community institution.
hero.subheadline: mosque.build brings mosque discovery, architecture, budgeting, permitting, fundraising, 3D design, procurement, construction, operations, madrasa programming, Ramadan planning, waqf, maintenance, and preservation into one platform.

problem.headline: Mosque projects are still managed across spreadsheets, WhatsApp groups, PDFs, donor chats, architects, contractors, map listings, payment tools, and institutional memory.
points: Communities often design before understanding need, operating cost, or zoning.
Architectural knowledge is fragmented across archives, suppliers, firms, books, and heritage records.
Capital campaigns frequently focus on construction while underfunding staffing, maintenance, utilities, and reserves.
Mosque managers use disconnected systems for donations, programs, cleaning, security, volunteers, Ramadan, and facilities.
Historic plans, crafts, lessons, and project knowledge disappear when committees change.

solution.headline: One connected lifecycle for the mosque.

product_sections.title: Find every mosque
product_sections.copy: A global mosque directory with maps, verified profiles, facilities, opening hours provenance, prayer and Jumuʿah information, accessibility, women’s spaces, madrasa, janazah, Ramadan programs and community services.

product_sections.title: Design on the real plot
product_sections.copy: Place the mosque on the actual parcel, orient to qibla, test floors and capacity, optimize prayer rows, compare structures and materials, simulate circulation, and see live build and maintenance cost impacts.

product_sections.title: Know what you can afford
product_sections.copy: Model land, design, permits, structure, finishes, equipment, staffing, cleaning, utilities, maintenance, reserves, and long-term replacement costs before approving a project.

product_sections.title: Raise money transparently
product_sections.copy: Fund the whole project or individual doors, wudu stations, classrooms, carpet areas, trees, solar panels, professional services, operating reserves, and waqf assets.

product_sections.title: Run the mosque after opening
product_sections.copy: Manage staff, volunteers, programs, madrasa, room bookings, cleaning, maintenance, inventory, security, compliance, Ramadan, iftar, janazah, annual reports and donor transparency.

product_sections.title: Learn from 1,400 years of mosque building
product_sections.copy: Explore architects, craftspeople, styles, materials, drawings, restoration projects, construction techniques, case studies and museum-quality component collections.

proof_future.headline: What mosque.build is building toward
items: Thousands of museum-quality mosque component examples
A mosque-specific 2D/3D design and cost engine

partner_cta.headline: Help build the knowledge and infrastructure layer for the world’s mosques.
partner_cta.copy: We are looking for mosque builders, architects, engineers, financiers, waqf experts, operators, scholars, data partners, software builders, suppliers, museums, universities and mosque communities to contribute expertise, data, case studies and integrations.

final_cta.headline: A mosque should be easier to build well — and easier to care for for the next hundred years.
